title: Petrous temporal bone and inner-ear neural relationships
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Explore author-defined skull-base sensory and neural context with preserved original source geometry.

scenes.title: Left Cochlea · source context
scenes.prompt: Compare the source cochlea and vestibule with the petrous temporal bone and neighboring neural components. Use transparency and rotation to understand their spatial relationships.
scenes.note: Original source object: Cochlea.l. Source world XYZ and source-defined laterality are retained. The display shows an author-defined educational model with the supplied contributor attribution.
